deadline.value: Apply by December 15 for full consideration; applications until February 15 may be considered.
deadline.quote: Fall: Apply by December 15, 5 p.m. EST for full consideration

gre_general.value: The Chemistry PhD does not require the GRE.
gre_general.quote: GRE: Not Required. If provided, it will not be used as evaluation material.

gre_subject.value: If a GRE is submitted it is not used in evaluation, including the Chemistry subject test.
gre_subject.quote: GRE: Not Required. If provided, it will not be used as evaluation material.

supervisor.value: The page says research duties are assigned by the major professor but does not say an agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: The page says stipends are available to eligible students but does not say how many admitted students get one.

entry_route.value: Either a 3.0 average in the last two undergraduate years or a master's degree in a relevant discipline is accepted.
entry_route.quote: Have a 3.0/4.0 average or higher during the last two years of the undergraduate program OR a master's degree in relevant discipline

notes: Pass proficiency exams in two of organic, physical, inorganic, analytical, biochemistry. Track options include chemistry education, environmental chemistry, forensic science and radiochemistry.
